latin: Sicut de solo intellectu uere dicitur quod est ignis, et quod est aqua, quod est motus, et quod est status, ita de sola anima uere dicitur quod frigefit, quod calefit, quod stat, quod mouetur.
translation: The intellect alone can truly be called fire, water, motion, and rest; the soul alone, correspondingly, can truly be said to grow cold, grow warm, come to rest, and be moved.
